rule: **C4 Unresolved references are preserved.** A call the tool cannot resolve is still emitted as a low guess (`recv.m`, `.m`, a bare name). It is never dropped and never promoted to a resolved ID. | Call on a **computed receiver** (call result, index, literal, `super` when the superclass is not in the scan): `.member` | **Typing reaches only declarations in the scan**
notes: Layout: src/ (the scan root) holds a Cargo package, Cargo.toml plus src/*.rs, so module paths are crate-relative. extcrate (a dependency, not scanned) and std paths are named statically → medium, IDs keep `::`. Their results' types are knowable only from library signatures outside the scan, so read_to_string(..).unwrap() is .unwrap, the untyped locals raw/handle give raw.len/handle.spin and the chained call is .spin, all low and all present (C4). A string literal is a computed receiver → .to_uppercase, low. call_type: SPEC lists direct|method without defining them; this corpus uses method for every callee of the form Type#m / recv.m / .m (including path calls Type::assoc()) and direct for free functions, module-path functions and named nested functions.
